summary: Added .gitlab-ci.yml with the nine stages and a real job in every stage except configure (Cloud Run, task 013). Verified in docs.gitlab.com on 2026-10-24: SAST and secret-detection templates (stage test, branch pipelines only by default, so the jobs are moved to secure and given MR rules); workflow:rules with CI_OPEN_MERGE_REQUESTS; release keyword with glab (release-cli is deprecated); docker:24.0.5 dind needs a privileged runner; Kaniko is marked no longer maintained, so Buildah is the package fallback (PACKAGE_BUILDER=buildah); CODEOWNERS compares with the target branch and needs Premium; push rules cannot block edits of existing files; pipeline execution policies need Ultimate. Added scripts/mutation_ci.py so the mutation gate prints NO MANDATORY FILES instead of an empty pass and fails when mandatory files have no engine results. Added a tools Dockerfile. Paper PDF decision: paper_pdf is the cheap git-diff check in govern; paper_build is a manual non-blocking placeholder because no TeX Live image is set up yet. human_only_files is not implemented: it waits for the tier report (task 012). collect_facts for GitLab is stubbed with an explicit notice until task 010.
next: Report the first pipeline: runners, dind or Buildah, native SAST and secret detection
